airport_info.name: Kotoka International Airport
airport_info.description: Main international gateway to Ghana and one of the busiest airports in West Africa

terminals.purpose: Main international terminal - newest and most modern

wifi.availability: Free WiFi available in Terminals 2 and 3
wifi.instructions: Connect to 'KIA FREE WIFI' and follow on-screen instructions

atms_banking.currency_exchange: Located in arrival and departure areas with competitive exchange rates
atms_banking.banks: Some banks have branches or ATMs at the airport

restaurants_dining.description: Selection of restaurants and cafes offering both local and international cuisine

bathrooms.family_rooms: Family rooms available for families with young children

shopping.duty_free: Wide range of products including electronics, cosmetics, and souvenirs
shopping.retail: Clothing, accessories, Ghanaian crafts, and local products

vendor.name: Smice Digital SIM card store
vendor.location: Left-hand side after exiting the arrival hall
vendor.operating_hours: Standard operating hours align with flight schedules (closes around 9-10 PM)
vendor.note: No official MTN or Vodafone stores at airport

requirements.passport: Required for registration - copy will be taken
requirements.unlocked_phone: Phone must be unlocked to work with local SIM cards
requirements.payment: Cash (GHS) most widely accepted, some counters may accept cards
requirements.extended_stay: Non-Citizen Ghana Card needed for stays longer than 30 days

pricing.sim_card_cost: Around GHS 30 ($1.87 USD) - may cost more at airport
pricing.note: Airport prices approximately double city prices ($4-$8)

airport_taxis.description: Official airport taxis - reliable and safe
airport_taxis.recommendation: Agree on fare before starting journey

ride_hailing.description: Convenient and often more affordable alternative to traditional taxis

car_rentals.recommendation: Book in advance, especially during peak travel seasons

public_transport.hotel_shuttles: Some hotels offer complimentary shuttle services
public_transport.buses_minibuses: Public buses and tro-tros available - suitable for adventurous travelers

popular_destinations.note: Taxi fares to major areas like Osu, East Legon, Airport City vary - negotiate or use ride-hailing apps for transparent pricing

security.emergency_contacts: Contact customer service for emergency assistance

lost_and_found.note: Report lost/damaged/delayed luggage immediately before exiting airport

terminal_2.departure: Desk located in departure check-in hall

terminal_3.arrival: Desk in arrival hall, baggage reclaim area

customer_service.information_desks: Located throughout terminals to assist travelers with inquiries

check_in_services.self_service_kiosks: Available for KQ, SAA and KLM passengers
check_in_services.opening_hours: Check-in counters open 2-3 hours before flight takeoff
check_in_services.recommendation: Arrive 2 hours before departure for domestic, 3 hours for international
check_in_services.baggage_wrapping: Available in check-in areas for added security

accessibility.mobility_assistance: Facilities for passengers with reduced mobility

arrival_recommendations: Arrive 3 hours early for international flights
Keep eye on flight information displays
Download airport or airline app for real-time updates
amenities_advice: Take advantage of lounges and dining options
